summary: Phase F4.9 — WhatsApp Provider bug fixes verified. Backend-only. Bug #3 (template_enabled toggle now persists) and Bug #6 (all event-trigger settings survive reload) both fixed correctly. 8/8 new F4.9 tests + 55/55 courier-sync/OFD regression tests pass. No code changes needed.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/whatsapp_provider.py line 325: template_enabled default is False. If any existing docs pre-date F4.9 (i.e. no template_enabled field in Mongo), they will now report template_enabled=false in GET responses even if they had a template_preview. This matches the design comment (`prior versions derived this from bool(template_preview)`), so the UI toggle will be OFF on first load after upgrade for existing configured triggers — main agent should confirm this is acceptable UX or add a one-time migration.

PUT /events/{event_key} silently drops empty-string keys/values in variable_mapping (line 738-740). This is fine but callers cannot explicitly clear one mapping key while keeping others — they must resend the full desired map.
